picker.empty: No matching teachers. Try a different keyword.
picker.footer: Choosing a teacher sets the suggested voice. You can adjust it in teacher settings.

my.androidDesc: Get the full Crew Teacher experience on Android.

vocabulary.androidVoiceHint: This app uses Android Text-to-Speech rather than Gemini Live. Change the voice in your phone's text-to-speech settings; playback speed can be adjusted here.
vocabulary.localVoicesHint: Only on-device English voices exposed by this browser are listed. Availability varies by device. Gemini Live is not used.
vocabulary.noLocalVoicesHint: No selectable on-device English voice is exposed. The system default will be tried. On Android, you can install English voice data in Settings → General management → Text-to-speech output. WebView may still hide some voices.
vocabulary.speechUnavailable: This browser does not support system text-to-speech.
vocabulary.speechFailed: Speech playback failed. Try another voice or review your device's text-to-speech settings.
vocabulary.goalCompleteDesc: You practiced {{count}} words today. Your progress has been saved.
vocabulary.fallbackNotice: Native-language translations aren't ready yet. Practice now with the built-in Traditional Chinese meanings; no API key is needed.
vocabulary.partialNotice: You can keep answering while translations finish in the background.
vocabulary.title: Learn words at your own pace
vocabulary.intro: Vocabulary difficulty adapts as you answer. Higher-level words are checked again, so one lucky guess won't advance your level.
vocabulary.preparing: Preparing definitions in your native language…

course.trackCompleteDesc: You've completed every lesson in this track. Choose another theme or review a lesson.

course.intro: Follow the app's learning path: 3 tracks, 10 units, 31 lessons. Complete each lesson to unlock the next.
